div.head: Leis Wl 42
div.ab: E qui dreite lei e dreit jugement refuserad, seit forfait envers celi, ki dreit ço est a aveir:
De hiis qui iustum iudicium repellunt. Qui legem equam et iustum iudicium subire renuit, forisfacturam reddat ei cuius erit iuris illam accipere:
E qui dreite lei e dreit jugement refuserad seit forfait envers celi ki dreit ço est a aveir.
42. Und wer gesetzliches Recht und richtiges Urtheil zurückweist, sei in Strafgeld verfallen gegenüber dem, dessen Berechtigung es ist, [es] zu erhalten:
42. And whoever rejects lawful right and proper judgement shall have incurred a money penalty to him whose entitlement it is to receive [it]:
And he who refuses [to observe] just law and just judgment shall forfeit a fine to the party who is entitled thereto.
div.note: Some of Liebermann’s notes here are cut off in the gutter of the scan used, and are still to be completed.
Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 270–271 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text and German translation added from Gesetze I p. 516, October 2026 (two independent readings of the page images)

note.seg: Nicht ‘zu erteilen weigert’, also ‘Justizweigerung begeht’ (so Frühere, auch Chevallet), aber auch nicht eng ‘Urteilschelte (s. d. Gl 3a) begeht’; o. S. 204, Sp. 3 Z. 1

Not ‘refuses to grant’, i.e. ‘commits a denial of justice’ (so earlier editors, also Chevallet), but not, in the narrow sense, ‘impugns a judgement’ (see that word in Gl 3a) either; above p. 204, col. 3 l. 1
